baseline_source: c760b13; unchanged raw closed-menu wide scenes from the ribbon-caption record, before subsequent menu refinements

gpu.scope: 12 raw wgpu client scenes: light/dark wide (1360x900), compact (700x600), short (480x360), each resting and Save-hover state.

scope: Classic v11 top bars use 16-point labels, 8-point horizontal button padding and 40-point targets in ordinary windows. Below 420 points tall, 32-point targets preserve the full ribbon and existing canvas interaction. Below 720 points wide, quick actions move to a separate row. Save/Share/Undo/Redo/Clear Canvas use the existing theme-tinted menu artwork with shared action metadata, enabled/selected state and tooltips. Default colored widgets and historical skin metrics remain their prior paths.
regressions: Six sizes/DPI/theme cases check target heights, font size, actual theme-tinted Save image, bounds, nonoverlap, menu spacing, repeated-layout stability, minimum visible canvas, Settings/changer interaction and auto-hide. Existing real canvas click and current-frame cursor-status tests pass.
short_window_failure: An intermediate 40-point layout left a 4-point canvas viewport at 480x360. Diagnostic failure logs are retained; those tests pass in the final responsive 32-point short-window layout. Final source retains the full ribbon with no new vertical-scroll behavior.
limits: Presentation and interaction qualification only. Full Windows/reference parity, native desktop/menu appearance, other ribbon spacing/artwork and remaining roadmap features remain incomplete. Client scenes do not include native title bars or menus. No native desktop window was launched for this slice.
